citation: Flad, Rowan K., and Pochan Chen. 2013. Ancient Central China: Centers and Peripheries along the Yangzi River. Case Studies in Early Societies. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. Online ISBN 9781139034852. DOI 10.1017/CBO9781139034852. Online publication 5 February 2013.
notes: Secondary Cambridge synthesis. Publisher abstract (Cambridge Core, accessed 2026-10-11): archaeological discoveries in upper and middle Yangzi (including Three Gorges); focuses Late Neolithic (late third millennium BC) through end of Bronze Age (late first millennium BC); discusses Chengdu Plain, Three Gorges, and Hubei; centers and peripheries of political, economic, and ritual activities not coincident. Use for regional Bronze Age framing beyond Central Plains only.
